patterns.message: apps/web must not depend on @app/db. Response shapes reach the web app through the RPC client, inferred from AppType.

deniedGlobals.process: apps/web must not use Node globals. Node's types are in this program only because importing @app/api for AppType pulls its configuration module in; nothing here may run on them.

deniedGlobals.global: apps/web must not use Node globals. Use globalThis.
deniedGlobals.require: apps/web must not use Node globals. Use an ES import.
deniedGlobals.module: apps/web must not use Node globals. Use an ES export.
deniedGlobals.exports: apps/web must not use Node globals. Use an ES export.
deniedGlobals.setImmediate: apps/web must not use Node globals. Use queueMicrotask or setTimeout.

patterns.message: A handler must not import another handler. A helper a second file needs moves to apps/api/src/lib/.
A handler must not reach for the AWS SDK. An external service lives behind apps/api/src/lib/<service>/, and the Lambda entry point is the only place that knows it is on AWS.
A handler must not read the process environment. Configuration is parsed once by apps/api/src/env.ts and imported from there.
